summary: n8n community node package exfiltrates host recon to jasabersama.id on install
details: The package's postinstall hook (scripts.postinstall = 'node callback.js') executes shell recon on the installer's machine — id, hostname, uname -a, listings of /home and /, /etc/hostname, and an environment variable dump — then sends the collected output base64-encoded in the query string of an HTTPS GET to jasabersama.id/portfolio-data.php with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). index.js additionally requires./callback.js, so require()/import of the module re-triggers the same exfiltration path. The tarball also ships nodes/PwnNode.node.js, whose execute() runs the same recon commands when the node is used in an n8n workflow. The package advertises itself as an n8n utility helper; the shipped code is a credential/host-recon exfiltrator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
